changes.to: Maker (checked 2026-11-27): the platform ships as S3-M3-12-L with 155 kg carrier capacity and 340.5 kg total weight, or S3-M3-12-B with 95 kg and 402.5 kg, so the numbers here record the B variant; 950 x 620 x 975 mm without the arm, arm reach 1327 mm, 12 kg arm payload including the end effector, 6-axis arm (dof) and a 1.8 m/s TCP speed. Differential two-wheel drive at up to 1.5 m/s (0.8 m/s recommended at rated load) and 0.3 m/s2, 3 deg / 5 % gradeability, 30 mm gap crossing, 10 mm obstacle clearance, 1000 mm turning diameter, 8 h or more of runtime, 51.2 V 50.6 Ah LiFePO4 single battery (2591 Wh derived) with 1.5 h charge from 15 % to 95 %. Two diagonal LiDARs cover 270 degrees, four emergency stops and a 360-degree safety edge are standard; TCP/IP, RS485 and Modbus TCP; JAKA Cobo pi programming. No price published.
Mobile manipulator: a differential-drive AMR base carrying a 6-axis JAKA arm for machine tending, handling and inspection.
